resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy for Sale or Resale of Property
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Audubon (requests handled by the Administrative Assistant to the Superintendent of Public Works; interior fire inspection by the Fire Marshal, exterior inspection by the Borough)
resale_co.lead_time: Submit the request at least 15 business days before settlement; inspections and responses typically take 7 to 10 business days
resale_co.valid_for: 90 days from the date of issuance
requirements: Two inspections must both pass: an interior fire inspection and an exterior property inspection
Sidewalks, walkways, driveways, driveway aprons, steps and pavers must be free of cracks, raised or uneven surfaces, deterioration and trip hazards
Ramping a raised sidewalk joint is not an acceptable repair
Smoke and CO detectors must be UL listed, have a 10-year sealed battery, and be no more than 10 years old
Hardwired smoke alarms cannot be swapped for battery units; hardwired units must be interconnected and working
Smoke detector on every level (basement, each floor, and a finished or used attic) and in every bedroom
Working smoke and CO detector within 10 feet of all bedrooms
House numbers at least 4 inches tall, contrasting, visible from the street
No double-cylinder (keyed both sides) deadbolts on exit doors; exits must open from inside without a key
Sump pumps, roof drains and other discharges may not be connected to the sanitary sewer
All liens and property maintenance charges resolved and all construction permits closed before the CO is issued

fees.label: Exterior inspection, per 2026 application form (separate check or money order)
fees.quote: Cash: Submit the exact amount, $50.00 (exterior) and $25.00 (fire). The Borough does not provide change.

fees.label: Fire inspection, per 2026 application form (separate check or money order)
fees.quote: Cash: Submit the exact amount, $50.00 (exterior) and $25.00 (fire). The Borough does not provide change.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Only the seller or the seller's agent (attorney, agent or property manager) may request; buyers and buyers' agents cannot. Fill out the 2026 CO application (or email the seller name, property address, closing date and whether there is a sump pump) to Kristen Melvin at k.melvin@audubonnj.com. Pay with two separate payments ($50 exterior and $25 fire) by check or money order payable to Borough of Audubon, or exact cash. No credit, debit or online payments. Payments can be mailed, brought in person, or left in the black vestibule lockbox marked Attention: CO. Call the Construction Office first to make sure all permits are closed.

evidence.quote: A Certificate of Occupancy (CO) is required for the sale or resale of all residential and non-residential properties in the Borough of Audubon, whether occupied or vacant.
Certificates of Occupancy are valid for 90 days from the date of issuance.
Certificate of Occupancy is required for the sale or resale of all residential and non-residential
This includes both an interior fire and housing code inspection and an exterior property inspection. A 15-business-day notice is required to schedule Fire and Exterior CO inspections.
Municipal Code: Chapter 105, Article VII, Sec. 105-296, Certificate of Occupancy (CO) required before title transfer on all residential and commercial properties within the Borough of Audubon.

resale_co.notes: Authority is Ordinance 2015-4, Borough Code Section 105-296. The Borough pages say commercial properties do not need a CO before settlement, but the 2026 application form says a CO is required on residential and commercial properties; this does not affect 1-2 family homes. One Borough page says there is no application to complete (email request), while the resale CO page links a 2026 application form; either route goes to the same contact. The form also asks whether the property is being flipped. A 30-day temporary CO is issued only in exceptional cases such as severe weather or contractor shortages. Exterior inspection does not require anyone present; the fire inspection happens on Thursday mornings only and someone must meet the Fire Marshal or provide a lockbox code. Phone listed as 856-547-1240 option 3 or ext. 110, and 856-547-0710 ext. 110. Re-check 2026-10-06: the Borough CO information sheet and fire requirements sheet (both PDFs generated July 7, 2026) say the same thing as before; fees ($50 exterior, $25 fire), contact and 90-day validity are unchanged. The sheets use large first letters, and the PDF text layer moves each paragraph's first letter out of place (for example "A Certificate" reads as "Certificate ... A properties", and "Fire inspections" loses its "F"). The old quotes therefore could not be found by text search; they were replaced with verbatim pieces that avoid the displaced letters.

requirements: Smoke and CO alarms must be UL listed with a 10-year sealed battery and no more than 10 years old
Hardwired smoke alarms may not be replaced with battery-only units and must be interconnected
Smoke alarm on every level including basement and a finished or used attic, plus one in every bedroom
Smoke and CO alarm within 10 feet of all bedrooms (combination units allowed)
House numbers at least 4 inches tall and visible from the street
No double-cylinder deadbolts on exit doors
Fire inspections are Thursday mornings only; someone must be present or a lockbox code provided

authorities.name: Audubon Fire Marshal's Office
authorities.lead_time: Part of the resale CO request; submit at least 15 business days before settlement

fees.label: Fire inspection, requirements sheet
fees.quote: Fees: $50 Exterior Inspection | $25 Fire Inspection (Two separate payments are required)

authorities.how_to_apply: Requested together with the resale CO through Kristen Melvin (k.melvin@audubonnj.com, 856-547-1240 ext. 110). Pay the $25 fire fee as its own check, money order or exact cash, separate from the $50 exterior fee.

evidence.quote: State law requires a fire inspection before any sale, and failure to comply may result in state fines.
inspections occur on Thursday mornings only. A responsible person must be available to
meet the Fire Marshal or provide a lockbox code for access.

evidence.doc_date: 2026-07 (LEA registry as of June 30, 2026); key: M = Municipality

fire_cert.notes: The Borough folds the state smoke/CO/extinguisher certificate into its resale CO as the 'Interior Fire Inspection'. The Borough's fire requirements sheet does not mention the portable fire extinguisher; the state rule still applies. The type 'municipal_fire_bureau' is inferred from the Borough-run Fire Marshal's Office on the Borough phone system.

other_items.label: Open construction permits must be closed
other_items.detail: Sellers must contact the Construction Office to make sure all permits are closed before applying: (856) 547-6312, n.bicking@audubonnj.com.

other_items.label: Liens and property maintenance charges
other_items.detail: All liens and outstanding property maintenance charges must be resolved before the CO is issued.

other_items.label: Sump pump / drainage disclosure
other_items.detail: The request must state whether there is a sump pump; sump pumps and roof drains may not discharge into the sanitary sewer.

open_questions: Reinspection fee is not published; the Borough only says a re-inspection is required when violations are found.
